subtitle: 7 strategies we're betting on for 2026
author: By Your Name, Co-founder @ YourCompany

strategies.label: STRATEGY 1
strategies.title: Cold email in a silo is dead
strategies.body: Single-channel sequences are getting cooked by AI-saturated inboxes. Multi-channel lifts response 287%.

points.title: Cold email in a silo is dead

strategies.label: STRATEGY 2
strategies.title: Relevance beats personalization
strategies.body: Clay hit $3.1B valuation / $100M ARR selling relevance, not tokens.

points.title: Offer fit > token fit
points.desc: 20 personalization points on a bad offer still gets you no reply

strategies.label: STRATEGY 3
strategies.title: Content is the best follow-up
strategies.body: Pipeline is being decided in DMs you'll never attribute. Content isn't top of funnel. It's closing.

points.title: 2% have a preferred vendor before evaluation

strategies.label: STRATEGY 4
strategies.title: One AI will talk to another AI before any human call
strategies.body: 67% of B2B buyers prefer a rep-free buying experience. Before two humans talk, their AIs already have.
strategies.takeaway: The pre-sales layer is now an AI-to-AI conversation.

strategies.label: STRATEGY 5
strategies.title: Sell the Ford before the Ferrari
strategies.body: Most companies don't know how to drive the Ford. You're selling them the Ferrari.

strategies.label: STRATEGY 6
strategies.title: Hire a GTM department, not sales + marketing
strategies.body: Anthropic: $5.6M revenue per employee. GTM engineer postings grew 205% in 2025.
strategies.takeaway: The separated-team model was built for a world where channels didn't overlap. They do now.

strategies.label: STRATEGY 7
strategies.title: The signal is the new list
strategies.body: Clay hit $100M ARR by running on 130+ signal sources. Top prospecting ICPs become prospecting moments.
strategies.takeaway: The list is the bottleneck. The signal is the leverage.
